 By Michael Howes PUBLISHED: November 14, 2026 at 12:07 PM EST | UPDATED: November 14, 2026 at 12:30 PM EST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... Brian Kelly, who was fired by LSU in 2025, has interviewed for Maryland's vacant head coaching position as the Terps continue their search for Mike Locksley's successor.
